target.statement: TPR/FPR/FDR of ILTFS-FDR on simulated IVFD (e.g., AR DGP, N=100, p=300, rho=0.10, Case I, gamma=3, q=0.05) — a single cell of the simulation results (Figures 1/2, Table 1)
target.dataset: Synthetic IVFD generated per Section 4 DGPs (BM/AR/MA), N in {100,200,500}, p in {300,500}

compute.basis: No code released; the full pipeline (IFPCA via basis expansion, IMDP initialization, M random-start concentration steps, Sn refinement, BH) must be reimplemented from the paper, and each reported cell is a 100-replication Monte Carlo average over N up to 500 curves on p up to 500 grid points — CPU-only but nontrivial to code and run.

blockers: No code or supplementary material linked in the paper
IMDP initialization (Tian et al. 2026) and several algorithmic details (M, d, basis Mj, epsilon) are not fully specified, requiring guesswork
Target is a Monte Carlo average over 100 replications, so a single run does not reproduce the headline number
title: Projection-Based Outlier Detection in Interval-Valued Functional Data
